title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator Teases New Story Changes for Season 3
content:
The Apothecary Diaries has returned to action with its third season of episodes now airing this Fall, and the creator behind it all is teasing some new changes to the story for this next season. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has kickstarted a wave of new anime releases through the month, and this includes some of the most highly anticipated franchise returns of the year. One of these returns was for The Apothecary Diaries as it has sparked a whole new mystery for Maomao to get to the bottom of.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has started to lay the groundwork for the central mystery that we’ll see play out through the rest of the Fall, but it seems like there are going to be even more surprises in store for the coming season than expected. Taking to social media , series creator Natsu Hyuga explained that this new season allowed them to add additional material to further flesh out some of the events in “greater depths” seen in the light novel and manga releases.

The Apothecary Diaries Creator Teases New Scenes in Season 3

“There are many parts where Season 3 comes before the manga,” Hyuga stated in a message to fans on social media. “While the original work is a novel, many aspects have been explored in greater depths through the manga. Keeping this in mind, I’ve been allowed to add additional material.” While Hyuga does not go into detail about the kinds of additional material that they have added to the new season’s scenes , it’s definitely good news for fans of the anime as it’s likely going to now be the most complete version of the story.

Thanks to the manga adaptation further enhancing the original novel version of the story, The Apothecary Diaries is now able to take things even further with the anime adaptation for this third season. The story between Jinshi and Maomao seems like it will be reaching a turning point through all of the promotional materials released thus far, so hopefully some of this additional material further extends to those moments. It’s something that fans of the wider franchise would surely appreciate above all else.

How to Watch The Apothecary Diaries Season 3

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is now streaming its new episodes with Crunchyroll this Fall in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and Indian Subcontinent (along with being available for Netflix only in select regions of Asia). This new season will be running for 24 episodes in total across two cours. The first half of the episodes will be wrapping up this Fall, but then it will be returning for its second half of episodes next April.

There are all sorts of new projects for The Apothecary Diaries in the works at the moment too. Not only is there a new movie hitting theaters in Japan later this year, but there’s also a new video game release coming next year. There’s also a new live-action series now in development for Prime Video too . We’re going to see much more of the franchise, so how are you feeling about The Apothecary Diaries right now? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Drops New Sneak Peek Ahead of Netflix Launch – Watch Now
content:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is coming back for a whole new season with Netflix, and the new series is gearing up for its premiere with an early sneak peek clip helping to show it all off. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners might have come to a complete end with its debut , but thankfully that was far from the end of the story. While it’s not going to continue with a traditional second season, the franchise is coming back with a whole new story with an entirely new group of characters in its wild world.

The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway as fans are seeing tons of new releases come to different streaming platforms , and Netflix is going all out with a new edition of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners . The new series looks to be covering different ground for its characters than the first did, and a new sneak peek has been released showing off more of its main cast. You can check it out in action below to get ready for its full premiere later this month.

When Does Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Come Out?

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be making its debut with Netflix on October 20th worldwide as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and this new sneak peek shows off more of the new cast of characters who will be making their debut in the new series. It’s yet to be revealed whether or not this can be considered a sequel with so many of the original characters dying off before the debut season ended, but that makes it all the more intriguing as to what could be going on. Especially as we see more of this dark and futuristic world.

The new main voice cast for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 includes the likes of Momoka Terasawa as Roman Carax, Akari Kito as Talia Yang, Koki Uchiyama as D, and Kentaro Tone as Weak Kingsley for its Japanese audio release. There will be an English dub release for the new season as well (launching at the same time) including the likes of Valeria Rodriguez as Roman, Kimoy Lee as Talia, Nazeeh Tarsha as D, and Clancy Brown as Weak. It’s the English dub that you can hear in action with this sneak peek too.

What to Know for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is also going to be carrying over much of the production cast seen with the first series with Kai Ikarashi (who directed the standout Episode 6 from the first season) taking over as director in cooperation with CD Projekt RED and Studio Trigger. Masahiko Otsuka and Bartosz Sztybor also return from the first series to serve as showrunners, story writers, and producers for the new episodes with Kanno Ichigo providing the new character designs.

It’s also been previously revealed that “You Can’t Run From Me,” written by Maria Kelly and Drew Polovick (who also produced the track) and performed by Rico Nasty will serve as the theme song for the new series too. With so much new energy being poured into the series, it’s likely going to hit all of the great beats that the first series did. There’s a hope that it can somehow match the greatness of that original debut , so what are you hoping to see from the new Cyberpunk: Edgerunners ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Dragon Ball Super’s Goku Hypes Anime Return With Special Video – Watch
content:
Dragon Ball Super is finally making its return to screens with a new anime later this week, and the voice actor behind Goku is sharing their hype for the upcoming premiere with a special new video. Dragon Ball is in the wake of celebrating the 40th anniversary of Akira Toriyama’s original manga debut with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and as a result we’re going to see plenty of new projects from the franchise. The first is coming our way later this week as it takes on the original TV series .

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is kicking off later this week as part of a new wave of anime premieres for the Fall 2026 anime schedule this October , and with it fans are going to see a new take on the now classic 2015 anime series. This new remake of the TV series will be bringing the classic to a new era of fans, and voice stars Masako Nozawa and Koichi Yamadera have shared a special message for fans that you can check out in action below.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Stars Get Ready for New Remake Premiere

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus stars Masako Nozawa (who voices Goku and many more) and Koichi Yamadera (who voices Beerus) have shared a special announcement message with Toei Animation as the two ready fans for the new remake anime series. Nozawa especially teases the enhanced visuals for the new series, “With the latest visuals, every scene, including the battle scenes, has become more intense and immersive. Please keep an eye out for all the new details!” And that’s going to be the most exciting aspect of this new serie s.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be re-adapting the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F, and Universe 6 arcs as seen in the original TV anime series, but is offering an “enhanced” version of those episodes with new visuals, sound effects and more . It’s yet to be revealed what that actually means for the pacing of each episode, but it seems like enough has been changed from the TV anime series to seem like a brand new series overall. Rather than just being a remastered version of the events like seen with Dragon Ball Z Kai , this might end up changing some big moments.

When Does Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Come Out?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be making its debut on October 11th in Japan, and will be streaming its new episodes with Crunchyroll for fans in the United States, Canada, Latin America including Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia and Europe that same day. It will then be followed by a streaming release with Netflix a week later on October 17th. Though both streamers will be offering a Japanese language release for the new series, any potential English dub release has yet to be announced as of this time.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has yet to confirm how many episodes will be running for this Fall, nor has it yet to reveal whether or not the other arcs of the anime will be getting their own remakes in the future. But that’s not all that’s on the docket for the franchise either as Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is a brand new anime series now in the works for the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc from the manga. Are you excited for Dragon Ball Super’ s return this Fall? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Previews 'Nocturne' in New Trailer
content:
The official YouTube channel for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) began streaming on Wednesday a trailer for the "Nocturne" story. The video previews the insert song "Tiny Luck" by Kairi Yagi .

The film is an omnibus film of three stories with different worldviews.

• "A(E)liens"

• "Yoroshiku★Girl," (also known as "4649 Girl," pronounced as "Yoroshiku★Shōjo," a pun on the words "Nice to Meet You★Girl" with the literal meaning of the kanji being "Evening Dew Heads to Its Death★Girl." The numbers 4649 can be read in Japanese as "Yoroshiku.")

• "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" ("Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni," literally, Nocturne: On This Grotesque Night, romanized in a previous video as "Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque.")

The film's cast members and characters include :

For the "A(E)liens" story:

• Kana Ichinose as Ellie

• Gen Hoshino as Kento Kurikura

• Akio Ōtsuka as Space Agency Bureau Director

For the "Yoroshiku★Girl" story:

• Sara Minami as Stella

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Unknown (Nanashi)

• Saori Hayami as Hikarin

• Maaya Uchida as Gorgeous Mika

• Chika Anzai as Sword

• Miyu Tomita as Chiffon

• Rumi Ōkubo as Papico

• Rie Kugimiya as Poyomi

For the "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" story:

• Nagi Inoue (from Nogizaka46) as Ayame

• Aruno Nakanishi (from Nogizaka46) as Shion

• Miku Ichinose (from Nogizaka46) as Momo

• Nao Tomisato (from Nogizaka46) as Canna

The 35 musical acts contributing to each story in the film are:

"A(E)liens:"

• Mika Ichinose

• VaVa

• Ken Kamikita

• sabio/Fūta Takamura

• SEE

• Surii

• Taku Inoue

• tsumiki

• Yūshi Nakajima (from Gusokumuzu)

• Nanahira

• Hashimero

"Yoroshiku★Girl"

• ASCA

• Akki

• -otoha-

• Kotoko Satō (from yutori)

• Kanon Shizaki

• Ayato Shinozaki

• JUNNA

• Suisō

• Ryōsuke Tachibana

• Shiina Natsukawa

• Iori Noguchi (from =LOVE)

• Shōta Horie (also known as kemu)

• Myuk

• MIRI

• Rei Yasuda

• Yuyoyuppe

• Runaar

• Reol

"Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque"

• eba

• Nakano+

• Kairi Yagi

Atsushi Nishigori ( The IDOLM@STER , DARLING in the FRANXX ) is directing the film, and is also writing the screenplay and designing the characters.

The band METALVERSE performs the opening theme song "Shoot Shoot Shoot." Haoto performs the ending theme song with lyrics by momosu momosu.

The film comes from JOEN , the company jointly established by Sony media subsidiary Aniplex , its CloverWorks animation studio, Production I.G sister company Wit Studio , and publisher Shueisha . CloverWorks producer Yūichi Fukushima and Wit Studio producer Tetsuya Nakatake are the representative directors of JOEN .

The film will open in Japan on November 6. The film had its world premiere at this year's Fantasia International Film Festival , which took place in Montreal from July 16-August 2.

The Japan Society will host the the U.S. premiere of the film in collaboration with CloverWorks and Aniplex of America in New York City on Thursday. Director Nishigori will give a pre-screening introduction in-person at the event.

title: Black Clover Creator Returns With Special Tribute for New Shonen Jump Anime Revival
content:
A major Shonen Jump series has finally made its official anime adaptation debut 16 years after its cancellation, and the creator behind Black Clover has returned to help celebrate. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway as a new wave of anime has started to hit screens through the month of October, and that includes some highly anticipated new releases. But there’s one series that’s actually a bigger deal than you’d expect as it was actually cancelled within Shonen Jump 16 long years ago and is coming back with a new revival.

Toshiaki Iwashiro’s Psyren was cancelled back in 2010 with Shonen Jump , and it wasn’t until all these years later that the franchise made its official TV anime debut. It’s a pretty big occasion as it proves that even cancelled Shonen Jump franchises have their chance at getting their own anime adaptations from now on, and Black Clover creator Yuki Tabata is going all out to celebrate with a special new sketch of Psyren’ s characters. You can check it out below.

Black Clover’s Yuki Tabata Returns With New Psyren Tribute

As shared through Psyren’ s official social media account, Yuki Tabata has shared some special art for the series to help celebrate its big anime adaptation debut. Tabata had previously worked on the series as an assistant to Iwashiro during the manga’s run, so it’s cool to see the creators celebrate one another’s successes like this. Psyren ran for 100 chapters before its cancellation, but this new anime adaptation is vowing to be a complete take on the cancelled series. But there are still many questions up in the air about what to expect from its run this Fall.

Psyren isn’t the first cancelled Shonen Jump series to be getting a new anime adaptation this year , nor is it the only one we’ll see in action this Fall. But what makes it even more impressive is the fact that it’s so long after that cancellation. It’s been 16 years since the cancelled series was cut short, and that likely means the anime is going to be the first time a whole new generation of potential fans will be getting their eyes on it. It could have a very successful revival if everything works out.

Where to Watch Psyren

Psyren is now officially streaming as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, and the first episode is now available to watch with Crunchyroll (where they are exclusively offering it outside of Japan). There will be an English dub release for the series planned as part of the streaming service’s schedule, but a release date or cast has yet to be revealed as of this time. Toshiaki Iwashiro has been involved with the production on the new anime to help it feel complete, so we’ll have to see what that means soon enough.

Psyren’ s new anime is dorected by Katsumi Ono with animation production handled by Satelight, Shin Yoshida handling its scripts, Akira Okuma designing the characters, and Takashi Ohmama, Tatsuhiko Saiki, Shu Kanematsu composing the music. If you want more of Black Clover instead, it’s also returned for its second season with new episodes this Fall. You can also find it streaming with Crunchyroll too.

How are you liking Psyren’ s anime revival so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

How are you liking Psyren’ s anime revival so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New Crunchyroll Anime Kicks Off Fall 2026 Premiere With Surprise Warning
content:
The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway, and one new premiere on Crunchyroll has really taken fans by surprise with a content warning to kick off its debut episode. A new wave of anime is now starting to make its debut this month as the Fall 2026 anime schedule kicks in, and there are quite a lot of new shows to keep an eye out for. Part of the fun of a new season is being surprised by the kinds of offerings that will be available for the coming months, and that’s especially true for FX Fighter Kurumi-chan.

If you have only seen it from the outside through its promotional images or maybe a teaser here and there, you might not have noticed just how dark of a start that it was going to have for its premiere episode. FX Fighter Kurumi-chan then took this even further with the opening seconds of its premiere episode providing a pretty intense content warning teasing the kinds of materials that the series would cover from here on out as it dives into the dangerous world of foreign trading.

FX Fighter Kurumi-chan Surprises With Content Warning Premiere

While anime fans are no strangers to seeing warnings ahead of certain shows based on violence or explicit content , that’s not the case with FX Fighter Kurumi-chan . The series might have kicked off with a surprise person taking their own life, but the anime made sure to fully warn fans about the true danger of the content it was adapting, foreign exchange margin trading that could lead to massive amounts of debt, “This is a work of fiction. Forex (foreign exchange margin trading) is a high-risk venture, and it’s possible for losses to exceed margin payments.”

“There is a risk that excessive trading can interfere with one’s daily life, so please think it over carefully and proceed with caution,” the warning continues. “The story contains depictions of foreign forex brokers and high-leverage transactions not in accordance with Japanese law, but there is risk involved in trading with parties not registered with the Financial Services Agency. Please do not attempt it.” With FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ‘s main character diving further into this world to clear her deceased mother’s debt, this warning paints a much more dire picture for how deep she’s set to fall within this world.

What Does This Mean for FX Fighter Kurumi-chan

If you have only seen glances of the cute main character, or watched the opening theme in passing (which you can find in the video above), it’s very clear that the surprise from the warning probably came as a shock. Unless you were already familiar with Demunyan and Daisuki Tansan’s original manga series, there was likely no real indicator (unless you knew what the “FX” in the title was referring to) that the series would be going to such lengths to depict the darker sides of foreign trading. Especially to clear out a mountain of debt.

But that’s also been the appeal of the series. There are lots of anime with cuter main characters taking on wild subjects, and this is just another example of that idea. It’s unique in that it’s tackling something that really hasn’t been seen in anime before, so if you’re curious make sure to check it out with Crunchyroll. There’s an English dub for the series planned as well .

title: Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game's Walkthrough Trailer Previews Combat, Customization
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a gameplay walkthrough trailer on Tuesday for Gundam Rogue Orbit , a new game in the Gundam franchise , and it previews combat and customization:

The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam on March 5, 2027.

The game will have a Launch Edition, Deluxe Edition, Collector's Edition. The Launch Edition includes reversible cover art, a poster, and a Gundam Card Game promo card. The Deluxe Edition includes the Premium Mod Skins Set, the Mobile Suit Color Pack 14-Color Set, digital artwork, digital soundtrack, and a Mission Reward Booster. The Collector's Edition adds a steel case, an exclusive HG 1/144 ARK-10 Gundam Helix (Earth Blue ver.) model kit, and a set of five Gundam Card Game promo cards.

In the game, players suit up as pilot RE-X and control Gundam Helix, RE-X's high-mobility suit. Other characters include Sofia, a mysterious young woman; April, captain of the Stellarvane; Big Paul, leader of a band of sand pirates; and Elaine, a knight commander and Mobile Suit pilot. The game features fast-paced battles, enemy hordes, and bosses. The story is focused on survival against an unknown enemy.

title: Our Blood Oath's Kazu Kakazu Launches Yosuga Tagurite Manga Series
content:
This year's 45th issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on Monday that manga creator Kazu Kakazu will launch a new manga titled Yosuga Tagurite on Shueisha 's vertical-scrolling manga service Jump Toon on October 9.

The manga centers on Yosuga, a half-human, half- yokai boy who is reviled as a monster. His destiny changes when he meets Shiki, a young man with the same golden eyes as him.

Kakazu launched the Our Blood Oath ( Bokura no Ketsumei , seen right) manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in September 2020, and ended it in January 2021. Shueisha released two compiled book volumes for the manga. Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and MANGA Plus both published the manga in English.

Kakazu published a one-shot in Weekly Shonen Jump in November 2019 titled "Seiyaku no Aka" (Red Pledge).

title: emaqi Service Adds Streaming Under My Control, The Soldier Groom and the Daikon Bride, Shin Ikki Tousen, 8 More Manga
content:
AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Tuesday that its emaqi e-bookstore service is adding 11 new exclusive titles this month. Eight of the new titles will be available through its " emaqi Premium" monthly subscription service. The company also announced emaqi 's new feature, a "chat assistant" feature designed to help readers find titles from the service's catalog, based on their mood and preferences.

emaqi 's exclusive new titles are:

Title: Streaming Under My Control Author: Yuka Tatami Release Date: October 6 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Maiko Yamakage, who his looking for a boyfriend and a job, meets the gloomy and unremarkable Aya Masuyama on a dating app. As they talk, she senses his potential as a video streamer and suggests he start doing live streams showing his face, but... A story of a streamer's growth, starring a positive woman and a negative man!! [E-book Bonus] Includes e-book-exclusive illustrations at the end of the volume!

Title: The Soldier Groom and the Daikon Bride Author: koma Release Date: October 9 Synopsis: One day, Hana, a farmer's daughter, receives a visit at her home from Homare, a young soldier in uniform. Homare then tells her that he came because he was informed today was to be his wedding ceremony...

Title: And So, We Mostly Destroyed Author: Ryokuji Yoshizawa Release Date: October 13 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Humanity has been defeated. People have mutated into grotesque monsters that wander the streets, attacking anything in sight. Civilization is on the brink of collapse. Almost everyone has been wiped out. But somehow a father and his daughter have managed to defy the odds and survive... Enter a unique dystopian world imagined by the genius mind of Ryokuji Yoshizawa!

Title: Shin Ikki Tousen Author: Yuji Shiozaki Release Date: October 16 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: The souls of the heroes who colored Three Kingdoms history are reborn in the present day! At last, the first collected volume of the acclaimed Ikki Tousen since its move to a new magazine! The stage: Nanyo Academy. And new transfer student Sonken is in for a brutal welcome on day one...?!

Title: Kill Me Baby Author: Kaduho Release Date: October 16 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Wanna be killed by the assassin Sonya!? For some reason, Sonya, a girl assassin working for a shadowy organization, attends a perfectly ordinary school. And then there's Yasuna, the fearless airhead who just won't stop clinging to her. Together, this duo deliver's razor-sharp killer gag comedy in 4-panel format!! These lethal knives are absolutely addictive!!

Title: Song of the Thirty-Year-Olds' Blues Author: Kawakami Daishiro Release Date: October 16 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Six friends reunite at their high school reunion at the age of thirty. They'd all found their footing in the real world and were living comfortable enough lives, but something still felt missing. Back in high school, each of them had a dream. Pro gamer, musician, comedian... Then one of them spoke up, "Let's give our dreams one more shot." So all six quit their jobs and moved into a shared house together. A story of passion, second chances, and adults who refuse to let go of who they were meant to be.

Title: Time Traveler's Disease Author: Tsuji Yamuri Release Date: October 16 Synopsis: Mirai, a husband who keeps his emotions locked away, lives happily with his bright, sweet-natured wife, Meguru. But Mirai carries a secret he has kept even from her... an illness that throws him back into the past whenever his emotions swing too far. One day, Mirai receives a suspicious phone call... and 3 days later, he learns that his wife has died. As his emotions erupt, Mirai is hurled into the past, and he sets out to save his wife... A time loop thriller about one married couple's future begins!! This digital edition reproduces the color pages exactly as they ran!! (*This e-book collects Chapters 1-8 of Time Traveler's Disease (Single Chapter Version). Please take care not to purchase duplicates.)

Title: Slow Loop Author: Maiko Uchino Release Date: October 20 Synopsis: "Lately, fishing has kind of been... really fun." Hiyori is a girl who spends her days fly fishing alone by the sea, a hobby lovingly passed down to her by her late father. It is there that she crosses paths with Koharu, the daughter of her mother's new husband form her remarriage. From this quirky little encounter, the two become "sisters." Why not take it slow and enjoy some quiet time "fishing" alongside Koharu and Hiyori?

Title: A Meal by Moonlight Author: Santa Uonome Release Date: October 20 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Genta Kono, 59, a former member of the yakuza, had been imprisoned for a certain crime. After serving a sentence of over ten years, he was released, but the world had completely changed since his time inside. Kono struggles every day to regain his independence as soon as he possibly can, when a young boy he's never seen before appears before him... In a town beneath Tokyo Skytree, a former yakuza with a criminal record and a young boy neglected by his toxic mother deepen their connection over shared meals, despite the pain they carry...

Title: My Maid Can't Keep Her Mouth Shut! Author: Ginmoku Release Date: October 23 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: It's good to be honest. Probably. When Shuji's parents went on a business trip overseas, they arranged for a maid to move in. She's cute, but can't keep anything secret! With a clear, innocent gaze, she casually blurts out the most outrageous things... A normal teenage boy in his second year of high school is about to have his life thrown upside down living under the same roof as a girl who can't help but say whatever's on her mind!! The author's first collected volume of a serialization originally released on Twitter .

Title: Orc with a Child Author: Misora Riku (story), Saitani Umetaro (art) Release Date: October 30 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Seven years have passed since the all-out war between demons and mankind. Three elf siblings call a peaceful village home, and what should appear before them but a survivor of the demon race--an orc!! In a panic, the younger sister, adventurer Alicia, draws her sword, but the orc is cradling a human child... The orc begs the elves, his enemies, to "please save this child"?!

Orange Inc. was founded in April 2021, and announced in July 2023 it had raised US$1.8 million. The company established its headquarters in the U.S. in March 2024.

Orange Inc. launched the app version of emaqi in May 2025.

The emaqi Premium monthly subscription launched on July 1.

title: Short Net Anime Studio Plott to Start Producing Over-the-Air TV Anime
content:
Plott , a production company known for producing short net anime streamed on YouTube , announced on Tuesday its foray into the terrestrial television anime business next year. The company initially plans to run three short anime series, one after another, on Japanese over-the-air television, and will handle the titles' planning, production, licensing, merchandising, and other business development. More details about the titles will be announced at a later date.

Plott recently launched on YouTube a new short anime titled Rakuraku Hanten on September 18.

Plott l aunched the first episode of Tengu Tōsen (Tengu Demon Sword Fight), a short anime project it is producing with Bandai Namco Entertainment , on YouTube on July 24.

The company previously produced the Anti-Hero Generations short anime adaptation based on Keita Uehara 's " Anti-Hero Generations " manga submission in 2022, which won the company's first "New Generation YouTube Manga Award" in 2021.

Plott is known for producing web anime shorts such as the adaptation of Torinosasami. 's Teikō Penguin manga , and Konketsu no Karekore ( Karekore of Mixed Blood ), the adaptation of Momota Inoue 's Karekore manga .

The company garners over 900 million monthly views across all its channels on YouTube , has over 14 million total subscribers, and its total number of views has exceeded 24 billion.
